newsitem.title: UK: UK meals/feeds see light preweekend short covering.
newsitem.headline: UK meals/feeds see light preweekend short covering.

text.p: Brokers on the UK meals and feeds market reported light short covering ahead of the weekend with buyers seeking corn gluten.
"Corn gluten is very tight in the nearby positions and buyers are having to chase the sellers, but there are not many people willing to sell," said one broker.
Corn gluten feed pellets traded at 109 stg a tonne for spot delivery ex-store Liverpool and Avonmouth.
Argentine sunflower meal 29 percent protein fetched 92.50 stg a tonne for spot in Newport.
On the rapemeal market spot A.D.M. material traded at 128 stg a tonne.
Brokers said again there was no interest in forward buying.
